basic_details.job_title: DLSA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Office Assistant, Office Peon Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Legal Services Authority (DLSA), Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri, Government of Telangana, has invited applications for 3 posts – 1 Office Assistant and 2 Office Peon – on contract basis for the Legal Aid Defence Counsel System. Only eligible candidates of Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri District may apply. The application, in the prescribed format and in a sealed cover, goes to the DLSA office at Court Buildings, Opp. New Bus Stand, Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri-508116, and must be received by 5.00 p.m. on 3 December 2026.

age_limit.details: Category Relaxation SC/ST/BC/EWS 5 years in the maximum age limit

Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post. | The appointment is on contract basis, initially for a period of one year or any date before that, and the staff can be continued till further orders or until the need ceases, as fixed by the Chairman, DLSA.

the Chairman (the undersigned) will decide the method of selection. No personal information will be given to any individual regarding any stage of selection
and no information will be sent to unsuccessful candidates after the successful candidates are declared.
important_instructions: Particulars given in the application form will be taken as final. Applications with insufficient information will summarily be rejected. Candidates shall furnish their phone numbers for correspondence. No TA/DA will be paid for the journey performed in connection with the appointment. Mere applying does not give any right to be selected. The number of posts may be increased or decreased at any time. For those applying for more than one post, the Chairman reserves the right to select the person to any of the posts applied. An application may be rejected at any stage if a claim is false; the appointment is liable to be cancelled and the applicant liable for prosecution for false information. The notification may be cancelled at any stage without assigning any reason and without prior intimation. No correspondence will be entertained in any respect.
The DLSA office number printed on the notice is 08685-298050 and its email is [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About DLSA Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri works under the Government of Telangana from the District Court Buildings, Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri. Its Chairman is the Principal District and Sessions Judge, who signed this notification. The posts are in the Office of the Legal Aid Defence Counsel, under the Legal Aid Defence Counsel System of the DLSA.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be made in the prescribed format enclosed with the notification (the application form for the post of Office Assistant/Office Peon). The filled form, with the documents, is sent in a sealed cover to this address: District Legal Services Authority, Court Buildings, Opp. New Bus Stand, Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri-508116 The notice asks candidates to mention the post applied for. It says the application is to be "sent in sealed cover" but does not name a postal mode such as speed post or registered post. Applications received after 5.00 p.m. on 3 December 2026 will not be accepted. The application form asks for: Name of the applicant with surname (as per certificate) and father's/husband's name. Date of birth and age as on 1.7.2026 (proof to be enclosed). Educational qualifications and technical qualifications (proof to be enclosed). Postal address with PIN code and mobile number. Community, and whether the candidate is PH or Ex-Serviceman (proof to be enclosed). Local Employment Exchange registration number with date of last renewal (proof to be enclosed). Previous experience, if any, and details of any civil or criminal case filed or being defended (case number, court, stage of the case). A recent colour passport size photograph, duly attested by a Gazetted Officer, affixed on the form, followed by the signed declaration with station and date.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Both posts are filled on contract basis. The notice prints the remuneration as a fixed amount and does not mention any allowance. Graduation Basic Word Processing Skills and ability to operate computer and skills to feed data Good typing speed with proper setting of petition Ability to take dictation and prepare files for presentation in the courts File maintenance and processing knowledge Age: as on 1.7.2026 the candidate must not have completed the age of 44 years Remuneration: Rs.20,000/- 7th Class Age: as on 1.7.2026 the candidate must not have completed the age of 44 years Remuneration: Rs.14,000/- The notice says no person shall be eligible for appointment unless he/she: is of sound health, active habits and free from any bodily defects or infirmities rendering him/her unfit for the service; has character and antecedents such as to qualify him/her for such service; and is a citizen of India. Applications are invited only from eligible candidates of Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri District. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post. The appointment is on contract basis, initially for a period of one year or any date before that, and the staff can be continued till further orders or until the need ceases, as fixed by the Chairman, DLSA.

rows.relaxation: 5 years in the maximum age limit

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Certificate of academic qualifications such as marks list, pass certificates, provisional certificate and testimonials Other certificates to prove technical efficiency, if any Date of Birth Certificate Community Certificate in case of SCs/STs/BCs/EWS, issued by the competent authority Employment Registration card Recent colour passport size photograph duly attested by a Gazetted Officer, affixed on the application form

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice does not fix a selection method in advance. Depending upon the applications received, the Chairman (the undersigned) will decide the method of selection. No personal information will be given to any individual regarding any stage of selection, and no information will be sent to unsuccessful candidates after the successful candidates are declared.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Particulars given in the application form will be taken as final. Applications with insufficient information will summarily be rejected. Candidates shall furnish their phone numbers for correspondence. No TA/DA will be paid for the journey performed in connection with the appointment. Mere applying does not give any right to be selected. The number of posts may be increased or decreased at any time. For those applying for more than one post, the Chairman reserves the right to select the person to any of the posts applied. An application may be rejected at any stage if a claim is false; the appointment is liable to be cancelled and the applicant liable for prosecution for false information. The notification may be cancelled at any stage without assigning any reason and without prior intimation. No correspondence will be entertained in any respect. The DLSA office number printed on the notice is 08685-298050 and its email is [email protected] .

rows.details: Prescribed form for Office Assistant/Office Peon

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Office Assistant and 2 Office Peon posts, on contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the DLSA office by 5.00 p.m. on 3 December 2026; applications received after that will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Office Assistant and Office Peon?
faq.answer: Office Assistant needs Graduation with word processing, computer data-entry, typing (with petition setting), dictation and file maintenance skills. Office Peon needs 7th Class.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: As on 1.7.2026, the candidate must not have completed the age of 44 years, for both posts.

faq.question: Q5. Who gets age relaxation and how much?
faq.answer: SC/ST/BC/EWS candidates get a relaxation of 5 years in the maximum age limit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs.20,000/- for Office Assistant and Rs.14,000/- for Office Peon.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form, attach the documents, and send it in a sealed cover mentioning the post to District Legal Services Authority, Court Buildings, Opp. New Bus Stand, Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri-508116.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The Chairman will decide the method of selection depending upon the applications received.

faq.question: Q9. Who can apply?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates of Yadadri-Bhuvanagiri District who are citizens of India may apply.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is on contract basis, initially for one year or any date before, and may be continued till further orders or until the need ceases.
